summary: Pair 3 clears the strict bar: F1.1 fully addressed with cross-lesson bridging ('Yesterday Lou built $1 many ways. Today extends to bills + mixed denominations. Lesson 4 hundreds; Lesson 5 capstones'). Trap is research-grounded (NCTM Principles to Actions on equivalent representations AND Carpenter & Moser CGI part-whole composition) with branched DIAGNOSTIC A/B/C recovery moves. Puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with stuffed-animal/picture substitutes; NO-MATERIALS PATH offers fingers as bills (whole hand=$20, thumb=$10, finger=$5). Tappy anchors all three lesson segments and closes with the chantable refrain 'BILLS for tens, COINS for cents — together they MAKE the AMOUNT!'. Mathematical authenticity hits Level 4 via STRATEGY COMPARE discussion prompt that has children compare $35 combos for fewest pieces and biggest-bill-first strategy, citing NCTM equivalent-representation principle. Worksheet Part 3 (fewest pieces for $50) is a transfer task that varies from the lesson's $25/$35 work — generalization verified. All six categories at 4.
